Thread read.** Triage comment (2026-08-25T15:59:43Z) read in full. Its serial note names the in-flight `#6194` / PR `#6359`. **Re-measured: PR #6359 is `merged`, issue #6194 is `closed`.** The serial constraint is discharged — no member of that component family is in flight. The triage-named fix shape is adopted verbatim below. **2. Shadow check.** Three devs in flight this round. File faces measured from their worktrees against `origin/main`: - `#5853` — `packages/types/**`, `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx` - `#5902` — `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`, `packages/plugin-form/src/occSave.tsx` - `#2628` — no file face yet (measure-first precondition) `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` appears in **none** of them. `#5902` shares the `plugin-form` *package* but a different file (`occSave.tsx`). No serial hold. **3. Call-site census** (`origin/main`, `git grep`): ``` "Loading columns…" → 1 site, repo-wide packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:243 ``` Single site. This is not a family sweep — do **not** widen it into one. ## Stale-premise check — the defect is still live ``` origin/main:packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:243

Loading columns…

origin/main:packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:351 // grid card shows a config hint, and `details` stays length-matched to origin/main:packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:382 return d; // leave as-is; the grid card will show a config hint ``` The decline itself is present and correct at `:353-355`. It is the **render** half that is missing, exactly as the card states. ## Scope 1. In `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`, split the `:242-243` branch so a detail entry with no `childObject` renders a **config hint naming `childObject`** instead of `Loading columns…`. Check the `childObject` arm **before** the columns/loading arm — nothing is pending for a declined detail, so there is no first paint where "loading" is honest. 2. Make the two comments at `:351-352` and `:382` true, or delete the claim they make. They are the reason this card exists: a reader followed them and had to run the component to discover the hint does not exist. **Prior art to copy, not reinvent** — `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx:327-334` (landed by PR #6359), verbatim shape: ```tsx {!schema.childObject ? (

This panel has no child object configured: set{' '} childObject to the object whose rows it lists.

) : loading ? ( ``` Match its copy register and give the new element its own `data-testid`. `AdvancedChartImpl`'s refusal placeholders are the second precedent. ## Test — read this before writing one `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.detailChildObjectDecline.test.tsx` **already exists on `origin/main`** and covers the **fetch** half only (`:113` data calls, `:121` the `console.warn`). It asserts nothing about what is rendered. - Extend it (or add a sibling) with the **render** half: mount with a detail carrying no `childObject`, assert the rendered text contains `childObject` and does **not** contain `Loading columns…`. - ⛔ Do not weaken or delete any existing assertion in that file. - ⛔ Ghost-assertion guard: an assertion that passes against **today's** `origin/main` is not testing your fix. Run the new assertion against unmodified `origin/main` first and show it **failing**, then show it passing after the change. Put both readings in the PR body. ## Out of scope — file, do not fix - `:240` `key={`${d.childObject}-${i}`}` collapses to `undefined-0` for declined details. Real, separate, **not** yours — file a `finding` if you confirm it. - The decline logic at `:353-355`. It is correct. Only the render half is in scope. ## Ground rules Worktree-first (`git worktree add ../objectui-6360 -b claude/issue-6360-master-detail-declined-config-hint main`). ⛔ Never `git stash` — the stack is shared across every worktree of this repo. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/` in a code PR; your release-notes input is the changeset. Changeset: `patch`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`. Open the PR as **draft** and report back — the PM lands it, ⛔ never self-merge. Size: S. Model: opus. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Five things the PM should know beyond the JSON:

1. The dispatch order's out-of-scope note about the React key contains a factual error, corrected in #6371 rather than repeated: the key does NOT collide. The map index makes it unique.
2. The catch-arm comment could not be made true within scope, so it was corrected instead. The dispatch order explicitly allowed this ("or delete the claim they make"). #6372 carries the behaviour.
3. Lint was a narrowed run, declared with all three evidence pieces (see the tests field and the PR body). Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
4. Deviation from the standing dev contract: the empty branch was NOT pushed as a first-minute write-route probe. The push at the end succeeded (exit 0), so nothing was lost, but the probe was skipped.
5. The PR body now carries TWO signature footers. The session-URL one is mine and survived the PATCH edit as designed; the platform appended a bare-form one on that edit. Cosmetic, and re-editing to remove it would just re-append it. Not another actor editing the PR.

Findings were filed unassigned with the `finding` label and no `pm:queue`, per the dispatch order and matching this repo's convention (#5939 precedent).
